title: Early Neurological Deterioration in Patients With Acute Ischemic Stroke
brief_summary: This study set out to explore the risk factors of early neurological deterioration (END) occurred in patients with acute ischemic stroke and to investigate the corresponding predictors.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects with acute ischemic stroke
* Subjects with detailed progress notes

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects with thrombolysis therapy
* Subjects with transient ischemia attach
* Subjects complicated with seriously underlying diseases
study_population: Patients admitted to First Affiliated Hospital of Nangjing Medical University from January 2015 to April 2018 were collected retrospectively.
